decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 2 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The access doorway to the restaurant shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced, details of the unisex disabled toilet are to be provided.  This toilet shall be designed in accordance with the requirements of Council's Think Access Guidelines in relation to design for accessibility.

Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted for a restaurant shall not be begun until details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  Such details are to include, but are not limited to details of a lobby area to the entrance.
Condition : 6 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and new shopfront to existing restaurant
